subject: general
question: According to the fundamental duties given in the Indian Constitution, it shall be the duty of every citizen of India to uphold and protect the sovereignty, _____ of India.
solution:
The correct answer is **__unity and integrity__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Fundamental duties come under Part IVA and Article 51A.
 
• These duties are statutory and are not enforceable by law but are taken into account by the courts while adjudicating any matter.
 
• Fundamental Duties in the Constitution are inspired by USSR.
 
• Japan is the only democratic country, other than India, to have Fundamental duties in its Constitution.
